title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Wikimedia…
description: A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Wikimedia Foundation's MediaWiki software, specifically affecting the WikimediaMessages Extension and the MinervaNeue Skin. This flaw involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation, linked to the i18n/wikimediaoverrides/en.json file. The vulnerability affects MediaWiki versions from 1.45.0 before 1.45.7, from 1.46.0 before 1.46.3, and version 1.47. The issue has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.6.
